summary: SOL Strategies Inc., a Toronto-based digital asset infrastructure company listed on the CSE and Nasdaq, furnished a Form 6-K attaching a September 15, 2026 news release reporting preliminary, unaudited monthly volumes for its wholly-owned Houdini Swap cross-chain aggregator: about US$65 million in June, US$66 million in July and US$74 million in August, up roughly 12% month-over-month and 14% versus June. Over 120,000 orders totaling about US$206 million were executed in the three months through August, with 55% touching Solana. The filing also notes management participation in a September 22 Water Tower Research conference and Stephen Ehrlich's move from Chief Strategy Officer to Director of Capital Markets. This is an operational update, not a special situation; no transaction terms or board recommendation are stated.
